title: Geometry of Living — A Poster Collection
description: The Geometry of Living, presented as an eighteen-chapter poster collection built on the kitab template. A systems-theoretic synthesis treating living systems as navigation through coupled manifolds under grammar, constraints, and thermodynamics. Chapters span the Perpetuation of Life (PoLPEST) framework; the geometry of movement, breath, mind, and music; health, disease, and healing; law, ethics, language, and civilization; nutrition and fasting; and the nested manifold of human reality. A sequel to Geometry of Becoming. Presented as an integrative research proposal, not established consensus. One poster per chapter, each a self-describing figure with explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools.
